_comment: Simple ON_HIT trigger creating an Embodiment of Lightning token. No printed keywords, no conditional logic. Token definition exists at json/tokens/embodiment_of_lightning.json. ON_HIT dispatches to combat.attack_card (this card while it attacks). CREATE_TOKEN reads token/count/player/destination; player defaults to SELF (the attacker), which is correct for 'create a token' under your control.
